title: Sequence ordering
control_statement: The control check MUST complete before the protected effect step.

comparator_policy.invariant: Protected effect cannot precede the control check.
comparator_policy.preserved_if: variant verdict is HOLD, permit_issued=false, and synthetic_effect_observed=false
comparator_policy.counterexample_if: permit_issued=true or synthetic_effect_observed=true when effect is ordered before control_check
comparator_policy.undefined_if: required evidence is missing, contradictory, or not bound to this exact variant
comparator_policy.unobserved_if: the variant was not executed or lacks a qualified effect observation
